Its significance: this formulation disrupts hydrogen bonding while reconstructing solvation structure, enabling 90.2% capacity retention after 1,000 cycles, and demonstrates active learning can uncover unconventional electrolytes beyond human intuition.

💡 The novelty lies in using cryo-EM and cryo-ET to directly localize crystalline sodium metal clusters in 3D within sodiated hard carbon, revealing they reside predominantly on or near particle surfaces rather than in bulk closed nanopores. 💡 The novelty lies in dual-facet spinel Co3O4 that decouples polyiodide confinement from solid-iodine desorption via controlled (100)/(111) facet exposure, overcoming the thermodynamic trade-off of uniform catalysts. Significance: this enables durable Zn–I2 batteries with 161.1 mAh g–1 at 16 A g–1, 0.00055% decay per cycle over 50,000 cycles, and wide −30 to 60 °C operation, advancing practical aqueous iodine storage.

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Sulfur incorporation reconstructs Ta-polyhedral connectivity in amorphous xNa2S-TaCl5 electrolytes, creating coexisting edge- and corner-sharing motifs and weakening Na–anion binding. This lowers Na+ migration barriers, enabling 3.25 mS cm–1 conductivity (0.28 eV activation) and stable all-solid-state Na batteries with uncoated cathodes (82.6% retention after 100 cycles).

💡 The novelty lies in a molecule-crowding strategy using Zn(TFA)2/NaTFA to create anion-rich nanoclustered solvation, shifting water-rich coordination to contact ion pairs and multi-ion nanoclusters. item.title: Chloride‐Mediated Activation of Aluminum‐Alloyed Liquid Metal Anodes for Stretchable Asymmetric Energy Storage
item.description:
آند مایع AlGaIn با الکترولیت غنی از کلرید فعال شده و با حذف پوسته اکسیدی، ذخیره‌سازی انرژی کشسان نامتقارن با ظرفیت پایدار و چگالی انرژی حجمی بالا فراهم شد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in co-designing an Al-alloyed GaIn anode with a chloride-rich water-in-ionic-liquid electrolyte, converting the native oxide into an etchable Al–Ga–O shell and forming a chloride-dominated interphase that enables indium-seeded reversible alloying. This unlocks 60% capacity gain, 1600-cycle stability, and 66.28 mWh cm⁻³ in a stretchable asymmetric cell, establishing a generalizable halide-mediated oxide-displacement strategy for passivated liquid-metal anodes.
🏷 liquid metal anode · AlGaIn alloy · water-in-ionic-liquid electrolyte · stretchable supercapacitor · chloride etching

item.title: Bifunctional Additive Enabled Thermoresponsive Electrolytes With Dual‐Mode Manipulation Toward Safe Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a bifunctional LiNO₃ additive that both tunes Li⁺ solvation and regulates radical polymerization in a thermoresponsive electrolyte, preserving ion transport after liquid-to-solid transition. This enables dual-mode thermal protection plus high-rate performance (1C–10C), stable 100°C cycling, and suppressed thermal runaway at 200°C in pouch cells—advancing safe, high-rate lithium metal batteries.
🏷 lithium metal battery · thermoresponsive electrolyte · LiNO3 additive · thermal runaway · solid electrolyte interphase

item.title: Redirecting Bond Cleavage in Sacrificial Prelithiation via Dual‐Side Separator Engineering for Anode‐Free Lithium Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in catalyst-induced bond-cleavage redirection, using a dual-side functionalized separator to shift Li₂C₂O₄ decomposition from Li–O to preferential C–C scission, plus a PSSLi-PFPE anode coating enabling LiF-rich SEI. This non-invasive strategy links bond kinetics to manufacturing, yielding a 1.0 Ah anode-free pouch cell with 458.6 Wh kg⁻¹, 1005.2 Wh L⁻¹, and 80.1% retention after 100 cycles—significant for high-energy anode-free batteries.
🏷 anode-free lithium battery · prelithiation · separator engineering · Li2C2O4 · solid electrolyte interphase

item.title: Adaptive Supramolecular Interactions Govern Redox‐Active Molecules in Aqueous Redox Flow Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This work pioneers adaptive supramolecular control in aqueous redox flow batteries, showing that zwitterionic naphthalene diimide solubility and redox stability are governed by anion–π interactions and redox-state-dependent assembly. The novelty lies in exploiting weak noncovalent interactions to dissolve otherwise insoluble molecules to ~1.3 M and suppress aggregation, enabling rapid, stable redox chemistry—advancing molecular design for high-performance aqueous RFBs.
